property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always calls the callee for the first element _tos[0] (so a recorder sees that recipient as the first recorded call); the mutant that starts the loop at i=1 omits calling _tos[0], which the recorder can detect for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the loop to iterate from 1 to _tos.length (skipping the first address), altering which callees are invoked and thus changing observable behavior.
